you_should_know.title: Texas lawmakers call on six Bexar County cities to end 287(g) agreements with ICE
you_should_know.summary: U.S. Rep. Joaquin Castro and others urge six cities in Bexar County, the county that contains San Antonio, to end their 287(g) agreements — the arrangements that let local police act as federal immigration officers — with ICE, citing trust issues and racial profiling concerns.

you_should_know.title: San Antonio mariachi community calls for release of Venezuelan musician detained by ICE
you_should_know.description: San Antonio mariachi musician, Reny Jesus Colina Torres, is in ICE custody. His family and local community are now calling for his release.
